sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Geared up, standing by for second guard.
Call from McDonald's Queen Street about a vagrant sleeping in store.
Received a call back from Queen Street McDonald's saying the manager approached the vagrant and the vagrant left; heading over to stand by for security presence.
Commencing welfare check on surrounding businesses.
77 Convenience Store, Localito, Starbucks, and Lumi Cafe all clear. Heading to the office to charge the Ops Phone.
Heading back on patrol towards Aotea Square. No sign of the second guard.
Welfare check on Starbucks, Localito, Queen Street McDonald's, 77 Convenience Store, and sweep of Aotea Square all clear. Standing by for security presence.

Received a call from Coffee Club High Street in regards to vagrants hanging around outside the store and asking customers for food or money, which is making customers feel uncomfortable. Heading to assist.
Library and Lorne Street all clear. High Street till Coffee Club also all clear. When I arrived no vagrants were seen; was told they must have left. Standing by for security presence.
Notified management regarding 1 guard patrolling and another guard being sent to work with me.
Arrived at the office. Standing by for second guard.
Second guard called stating he will be here shortly.
Second guard arrived on site. Heading out on patrols.
Welfare check High Street and businesses open within the area, commencing sweep at Freyberg Place and Chancery Square.
Sweep Freyberg Place, all clear, no issues identified.
Swept Chancery Square, welfare check on businesses open in the area, all clear, no issues, patrolling down to Shortland.
Welfare check Connell Street and businesses open within the area, all clear.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane and all businesses open, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep High Street, Vulcan Lane, Connell Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Shortland Street and all businesses open, all clear, no issues, patrolling down Fort Lane.
Arrived at Fort Lane, commencing sweep through the area.
Full sweep Fort Street, Fort Lane, welfare check on all businesses open, all clear, no issues to report, heading back to office to charge work phone.
Arrived at Headquarters, charging work ops phone due to low percentage. (on file) Responding to active calls that occur while in office charging.
Commencing patrols on lower Queen Street.
Full sweep lower Queen Street, welfare check on all businesses open, all clear, no issues to report, patrolling down to Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart / Commercial Bay, will be standing by maintaining our presence due to a lot of footwork in the area.
Full sweep Commercial Bay / Britomart downtown waterfront and all businesses open, all clear, continuing patrols on Albert Street.
Bottom half of Albert Street welfare checks, all clear, no issues, patrolling up to St Patrick's Cathedral.
Full patrol sweep St Patrick's Cathedral, Federal Square, welfare check Albert Grocery Store, all clear, no issues.
Federal Street all clear, no issues identified.
Sweep Victoria Street West, welfare check 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Top half of Albert Street all clear, patrolling down Mayoral Drive.
Mayoral Drive check-in all clear, no issues to report, patrolling up to Aotea Square to commence full sweep.
Arrived at Aotea, no risks identified in the area so will be making a quick sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square, no issues, all clear, patrolling down Queen Street heading to HQ to commence break.
Arrived at HQ, commencing 30 minute break and preparing for afternoon shift handover.
Morning shift has been concluded, handing over to night shift.
Equipment handover: 4 x Keys, 2 x Vests, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Keytag, 1 x Phone.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Debrief with morning shift; will gear up and conduct welfare checks.
Debrief completed, geared up and commencing welfare checks. Heading down Queen Street.
Welfare check-in lower Queen Street, High Street, Freyberg and Chancery Square. No issues to report on stores in the vicinities. Continuing patrol.
Welfare sweep on Shortland Street, Fort and Gore Street complete, no issues to report. Heading to Commercial Bay.
Welfare sweep on Fort Street clear, no issues, conducting sweep on Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay sweep conducted and completed, no issues to report. Heading up Albert Street to Victoria Street.
Albert Street check clear, no issues to report. Arrived at Victoria Street, conducting sweep on Victoria Street, no issues, also completed sweep.
Response call from Mountain Warehouse requesting assistance for a removal from the property; the reason being the vagrant has fallen asleep and is being inappropriate in store.
Arrived at store, currently moving the vagrant out.
Vagrant has been removed, but also noticed that he had stolen a shirt from Hallensteins Queen Street; collecting and returning the shirt now.

Also noticed that the vagrant had an injured foot; will contact the ambulance for a medical assessment. (Note: also contacted Auckland Council to request a shirt as the vagrant has none and is cold.) Will be standing by the vagrant until then, no further issues (trespass notice has been given by Mountain Warehouse).
Vagrant has been given the shirts and moved along with no further issues, continuing patrol.
Whilst on patrol came across a vagrant being removed from New World; the vagrant was being aggressive towards the security and staff, standing by for assistance.
Vagrant from New World removed, was aggressive but no altercations were caused, no further issues to report. Resuming patrol up Queen Street.
Sweep Wyndham Street, all clear, patrolling St Patrick's Square.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub and Albert Grocery Mart.
Arrived at St Patrick's Square, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep St Patrick's Square, Federal Square, Cathedral, Liston House, all clear.
Welfare check Federal Street, no issues.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues to report.
Top half of Albert Street all clear, no issues to report, walking down Mayoral Drive.
Whole sweep Mayoral Drive, all clear, no issues to report. Arriving at Aotea Square to commence full sweep in the area due to a lot of footwork seen in the area.
Full sweep Aotea Square, no issues identified in the area, patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Red Radisson, Lorne Street Square Centre and all businesses open within the area.
Received a response call regarding a male individual sleeping inside Red Radisson and causing a disturbance on premises, en route to location.

Arrived at response location; the male individual was inside the premises sleeping on the couch. Approached and asked him to leave the site; as we left, the male individual requested he had left his belongings on the property, but we fully checked and asked staff and were told there were no belongings of his at all in Red Radisson, so we called the police for him, but were in a very sticky situation, so we escorted him to the police station.
Arrived at police station, assisting the male individual with any situations needed.
We have also issued a police-certified trespass and have read it to him. (recording on file) All clear, no issues to report, heading back to HQ.
Received a call to let the standby guard in. Standby guard has been let in.

Received a text message from 33 Lorne Street regarding an incident with a male vagrant urinating in their business; received footage and will be putting it on Auror. Due to low units of guards, will be handing this incident over to night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:45 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Heading to Ace Karaoke on standby, showing security presence.
Arrived at Ace Karaoke on standby, showing presence.
Guard has arrived, heading down to Darby Street due to heavy foot traffic.
Arrived on site on standby, showing presence.
No issues here at Bar101 / Darby Street.
Check-in Queen Street McDonald's / Avachi / Localito / Cue City, no issues to report.
Check-in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues.
Full sweep Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Fort Street / Wilson Carpark / White Lady / Jo & Joe's / Evan's Kebabs, all clear, no issues.
On standby at Sapphire, showing security presence.
No issues at Sapphire. Heading back to HQ due to phone on low percentage.
Arrived at HQ on standby, charging ops phone on 8%.
Heading back out on patrols, phone is on 40%.
On standby at Bar101 showing security presence.
No issues at Bar101 to report. Patrolling Queen Street; Queen Street all clear.
On standby outside Mothership showing security presence.
All clear at Mothership, no issues.

Responded to a call from Britomart McDonald's due to an individual passed out in front of Britomart McDonald's, unresponsive; we called an ambulance and are now on standby next to her till the ambulance arrives.
Ambulance have arrived, handed over the individual to them, no further issues. Patrolling Quay Street.
Heavy intoxicated crowds on Quay Street but no one causing any issues.
Check-in AAS / Providor, no issues to report.
Check-in Danny's / Rosie's, no issues to report.
Welfare check marina guards, no issues.
Check-in Albert Convenience Store, no issues. Heading back to HQ for 3rd guard clocking off.
On standby on Elliott Street waiting for the Bar101 crowd to clear up.
Elliott Street / Darby Street and Wilson Carpark all clear, no issues to report.
On standby at Queen Street McDonald's.
Queen Street McDonald's all clear, closed for cleaning.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear, no issues.
Check-in corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Lorne Street / High Street, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener Street, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ for 30 minutes break.
Break ended, night shift concluded, handover complete.
